objects.description: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) used tools such as [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) and [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) to dump credentials from victim systems.(Citation: Picus BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)
objects.description_fa: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) از ابزارهایی مانند [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) و [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) برای دور انداختن اعتبارنامه‌ها از قربانی استفاده کرد. سیستم‌ها.(Citation: Picus BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)
